A few helpful details

Before you enquire.

How do I ask about a piece?

Open a photo in the collection, add your preferences and save it to My picks. You can copy a request, open a WhatsApp draft or use the contact form to put your idea into words.

Where are the prices and available sizes?

The photos show portfolio examples. Ask the makers for the current price, sizing, materials and availability for the specific piece you have in mind.

Can I request a different colour or a custom piece?

You can describe your preferences in an enquiry. The makers will confirm which changes are possible, along with any price and timing details.

What about delivery?

Include your town or area in your message. Confirm current delivery coverage, fees and timing directly before placing an order.

Can I visit?

Visits are by appointment. Contact the makers before coming.

Your privacy

Your saved picks use this browser’s local storage. You can clear them in My picks. This preview uses no analytics, advertising cookies or contact-form server. WhatsApp, Instagram and Maps have their own privacy policies when you open them.
